The Receiving Party must provide the Disclosing Party with reasonable advance notice of the required disclosure and reasonably cooperate, at the Disclosing Party's expense, with the Disclosing Party's efforts to obtain confidential treatment for the Confidential Information.

This provision interacts with the general confidentiality obligations in Section 2 by allowing the Receiving Party to disclose Confidential Information when required by law, while still providing the Disclosing Party with an opportunity to take steps to protect the confidentiality of that information.
The notice requirement ensures that the Disclosing Party is aware of the planned disclosure and can work together with the Receiving Party to minimize any potential harm from the disclosure.

The Cache-Control header field is used to specify directives that MUST be obeyed by all caching mechanisms along the request/response chain

The directives specified in this header field can influence how caches handle responses
For example, the 'max-age' directive allows a client to specify the maximum age it is willing to accept of an unvalidated response
In particular, the Cache-Control header field provides mechanisms for clients to control cache behavior in situations where the origin server does not provide explicit expiration times
